text:
evan: Capturing follow-ups from the postmortem: missing spans + bad rollups + ETL lag. Posting owners + timelines. Please ack.

maya: TL;DR: exporter timeouts at the collector dropped spans; rollup job had a NULL key aggregation bug that excluded buckets; ETL retries/backfill needed.

priya-analytics: I'll take the rollup null-coalesce change and add unit+integration tests. Also creating a nightly reconciliation job to compare raw_span_count -> aggregated_count. ETA: 2026-03-20.

sam-sre: I'll add span-ingest alerts (P1/P2 thresholds) and a runbook with collector shard restart steps + exporter healthchecks. Also adding a post-deploy smoke test for exporter latency. ETA: 2026-03-11.

evan: I'll own the backfill orchestration and the collector buffer patch (bounded queue + retry with jitter). Plan: canary to 5% shards, monitor queue_drops metric. ETA: 2026-03-25.

ci-bot: deploy: obs-collector v2.1.6 -> v2.1.7 staged canary at 2026-03-10T16:22Z.

priya-analytics: Backfill policy proposal: auto-trigger if aggregated_count < raw_count * 0.92 for a 1h window; require manual approval for >24h gaps. Rate-limit backfill to 2x normal ingestion to avoid overload.

sam-sre: +1 but add an operator override and a safe-mode to slow backfill if exporter errors increase. Also a dashboard tile showing backfill progress.

maya: Noting recurrence: 3 incidents in 9 months with similar symptoms. We're scheduling a 2-week reliability spike after this round of fixes to harden exporter/collector protocol and add smoke tests.

evan: action snapshot:
```
action,owner,eta,status
rollup-null-coalesce,priya-analytics,2026-03-20,open
span-ingest-alerts,sam-sre,2026-03-11,open
collector-buffer+retry,evan,2026-03-25,open
reconciliation-nightly,priya-analytics,2026-03-18,open
backfill-orchestration,evan,2026-03-25,open
reliability-spike,maya,2026-04-05,open
```

priya-analytics: Accepted. :white_check_mark: I'll post PR and test links to the PM doc.

sam-sre: Accepted. :white_check_mark: Runbook draft in infra repo.

evan: Accepted. :white_check_mark: Will link canary metrics.

maya: I'll run weekly check-ins and escalate if an ETA slips >3 days with no update. Thanks team.
